steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 47
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: There's a real generation gap in how we use technology.
The story comes from local folklore.
The old town is a protected cultural heritage site.

steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "generation gap"?

steps.title: Gramática: First Conditional
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "First Conditional"?
options: I visited my grandmother last week.
If I had money, I would buy a car.
If it rains, I will stay home.

steps.title: Idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
steps.text: It means: "To be very expensive.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: That car cost an arm and a leg.
